methodology: Three fresh independent agents received only the staged skills, referenced material and constructed benign raw requests, not project history, expected answers or suspected fixes. Root inspected actual reports, code, numerical JSON and the generated plot. Tests are synthetic preparation exercises, not current contest results.
limitations: Single representative run per scenario; no statistical success rate, prize prediction or full contest solution
Step 1 retained the prior reading behavior with new shared links and stage handoffs; it received content/structure/load checks but no new separate read-through exercise
Step 3 tested one real discussion turn and preserved undecided status, not a multi-round agreement with the real user
No long-running failures, large-scale optimization, complete final manuscript or official submission tested
Historical v1.0/v1.1 tests were not rerun against v2.0
Desktop menu refresh timing not tested; app-server discovery, descriptions and enabled status verified
archive_note: Fourteen selected small test artifact files copied from isolated directories, excluding font cache. Original programs, numerical records and execution commands preserved; Markdown links point to retained artifacts. Test reports use user for their test requester; exercises were constructed by root.
